scope: Isolated duplicate-mannequin collar, upper support and one sleeve; not a full character candidate.

criteria.fabric_thickness_and_overlap: PARTIAL: broad front panels genuinely overlap; connected nape/attached band, but neckline and seam spacing remain coarse.
criteria.natural_shoulder_sleeve_continuity: FAIL: joined mesh surface exists, but pinned shoulder seam sits too high and reads as a plate, especially profile/3-quarter.
criteria.wide_sleeve_silhouette: OBSERVED: one wide hanging fabric bag and distal opening, unlike the short radial tube.
criteria.plausible_folds_volume: PARTIAL: gravity-derived back/torso tension folds and hanging sleeve mass; folds gather too sharply at armpit.
criteria.no_obvious_intersections: NOT_CERTIFIED: neutral major body breakthrough is not obvious, but dark root folds/gaps and raised-pose angular artifacts leave intersection risk.
criteria.basic_arm_deformation: FAIL: actual ordinary armature raise reveals sharp root pinching; no solver/corrective morph used to disguise it.

new_method_trials.reason: Best readable broad sleeve/drape among tests; final adds continuous nape seam.
Softer pins and anatomical shoulder placement collapse sleeve/root during long drape.
Clearance placement/higher bending reduce some collapse, but bag/root remain crumpled and restricted.

stop_reason: Three new-method trials exhausted; no further aesthetic repairs before human direction.
next_method_recommendation: Keep explicit panel/seam topology but hand-fit the yoke and armhole first; restrict cloth to free sleeve bag/hem with stable boundary, transfer/smooth binding at root. Test flat pattern/seam layout before another full-surface solve.
